// @autogenerated
[#message]
= Message

Outbox entry for an outgoing notification (currently an email): the rendered content waits here until the dispatcher sends it, retrying on failure.

== Dónde se encuentra

No aparece en el menú: se llega desde otra entidad.

== Campos

[cols="2,2,1,5",options="header"]
|===
|Campo |Tipo |Obligatorio |Detalles

|Objetivo
|Texto
|Sí
|Recipient address of the notification (the destination email).

|inquilino
|Tenant (referencia)
|No
|Tenant that sends the message; selects its SMTP configuration. Empty for system-wide messages, which use the global configuration.

|urgente
|Sí / no
|Sí
|Sends the message right away instead of waiting for the next dispatch cycle. Valor inicial: «false».

|contenido
|Texto largo
|Sí
|Rendered content to send, as JSON with subject, html and text; when it is not valid JSON it is sent as raw HTML.

|reintentos
|Número entero
|Sí
|Failed delivery attempts so far; the message is abandoned once it reaches the max-retries of the SMTP configuration.

|creado en
|Fecha y hora
|Sí
|When the message was queued. Valor inicial: «now». Lo calcula la aplicación: no se edita.

|Enviar a
|Fecha y hora
|No
|Earliest time to send the message; empty sends it in the next dispatch cycle. Lo calcula la aplicación: no se edita.

|bloquear en
|Fecha y hora
|No
|When a dispatcher took the message to send it; a lock older than two minutes is considered abandoned and the message becomes eligible again. Lo calcula la aplicación: no se edita.
|===

== Acciones

[cols="1,3",options="header"]
|===
|Acción |Qué hace

|Crear
|Da de alta un elemento nuevo.

|Consultar
|Muestra los valores de un elemento.

|Editar
|Cambia los valores de un elemento.

|Borrar
|Borra un elemento, o los seleccionados, tras confirmarlo.
|===
